description: Pittsburgh Regional Transit Stops is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Pittsburgh Regional Transit. All transit stops within the Pittsburgh Regional Transit's service area for the current schedule period. The data files in this dataset are pulled from the current stops dataset on the PRT's data portal on a weekly basis. Note: historical stops from February 2023/present are available at:. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Pittsburgh Regional Transit. Its tags are _etl, bus, incline, light rail, pittsburgh rapid transit. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
